# 2 Baruch Chapter 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**1** On the day Jerusalem fell, I Baruch was standing on the city wall. I looked up and saw four angels standing at the four corners of the city, each holding a lit torch.

**2** Then another angel came down from heaven and said to them: "Put out your torches — don't light them yet until I give you the word.

**3** I have been sent first to speak to the earth, and after I have gathered up what belongs to it, then you may light your torches."

**4** I watched him go down into the Most Holy Place and take out: the great curtain, the sacred vestments, the ark cover, the two tablets of the Law, the priestly garments, the incense altar, the forty-eight precious stones the high priest wore, and all the sacred vessels of the sanctuary.

**5** He called out to the earth in a thundering voice: "Earth, earth, earth! Hear the word of the Almighty God! Receive what I am entrusting to you. Guard these things until the last days. When you are commanded, return them — so that foreigners cannot have them."

**6** The earth opened up and swallowed everything.

**7** Then I heard that same angel say to the torch-bearing angels: "Now tear down the walls to their very foundations — so the enemy cannot boast and say, 'We are the ones who destroyed Zion and burned down God's sanctuary.'"

**8** Then they took hold of me and carried me away, along with the sacred vessels, to a place beyond the Jordan.

**9** The Lord allowed the wall to be knocked down, and the enemy came in and occupied the city.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. "Most Holy Place" for "Holy of Holies." "Ark cover" for "mercy seat." "Great curtain" for "veil." "Almighty God" for "mighty God." The divine speech to earth (v.5) rendered with dramatic force.*
